create_stereo_dataset: create a StereoDataset subclass instance for a specific stereo benchmark like SceneFlow or KITTI
build_train_dataset_stereo: build a training stereo dataset from a string spec with augmentation and crop size
build_test_datasets_stereo: build a list of test stereo datasets from a plus-separated string spec
convert_image_to_tensor: convert a numpy RGB image to a normalized PyTorch tensor using ImageNet statistics
visualize_disparity_map: visualize a disparity map as a color-coded image using OpenCV inferno colormap
